hebrewText: כַּפְתֹּרֵי/הֶ֥ם וּ/קְנֹתָ֖/ם מִמֶּ֣/נָּה יִהְי֑וּ כֻּלָּ֛/הּ מִקְשָׁ֥ה אַחַ֖ת זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר

tokens.bdb: a chaplet; but used only in an architectonic sense, i.e. the capital of acolumn, or a wreath-like button or disk on the candelabrum
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a chaplet; but used only in an architectonic sense
tokens.enLiteralWord: a chaplet; but used only in an architectonic sense
tokens.explanation: a chaplet; but used only in an architectonic sense
tokens.explanationEn: a chaplet; but used only in an architectonic sense

tokens.bdb: a reed (as erect); by resemblance a rod (especially for measuring), shaft, tube, stem, the radius (of the arm), beam (of a steelyard)
tokens.kjv: balance, bone, branch, calamus, cane, reed, [idiom] spearman, stalk.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a reed ; by resemblance a rod
tokens.enLiteralWord: a reed ; by resemblance a rod
tokens.explanation: a reed ; by resemblance a rod
tokens.explanationEn: a reed ; by resemblance a rod

tokens.bdb: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
tokens.kjv: above, after, among, at, because of, by (reason of), from (among), in, [idiom] neither, [idiom] nor, (out) of, over, since, [idiom] then, through, [idiom] whether, with.

tokens.bdb: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
tokens.kjv: beacon, [idiom] altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall, [phrase] follow, happen, [idiom] have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, [idiom] use.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
tokens.explanation: kol — todo, toda, qualquer, totalidade de algo

tokens.bdb: rounded work, i.e. moulded by hammering (repousse)
tokens.kjv: beaten (out of one piece, work), upright, whole piece.

tokens.bdb: properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first
tokens.kjv: a, alike, alone, altogether, and, any(-thing), apiece, a certain, (dai-) ly, each (one), [phrase] eleven, every, few, first, [phrase] highway, a man, once, one, only, other, some, together,
tokens.explanation: echad — um, unido, o primeiro (numeral ordinal)

tokens.bdb: gold, figuratively, something gold-colored (i.e. yellow), as oil, a clear sky
pure (in a physical, chemical, ceremonial or moral sense)
